title: Anthropic’s Secret IPO Filing Just LEAKED… The Numbers Are INSANE
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: A ~$2T IPO is justifiable only if the public filing shows revenue still above $11.5B/quarter with profit held; no need to buy on day one.
Anthropic's $518B compute commitments are the real risk if demand stalls, and much of it flows back to investors Google and Amazon.
SpaceX lock-up unlocks in October and November could still add selling pressure.

calls.condition: Wants to begin buying around $60 fair value
calls.reason: Thinks SpaceX is overvalued and that remaining lock-up unlocks (two in October, a big one in November) add supply; admits his $60 call has been wrong so far.
calls.quote: I'm still looking for it to go lower. I think it's a bit overvalued at the current price.

calls.condition: Buy if the public prospectus shows revenue still climbing past $11.5B/quarter with profit held; avoid if sales flatten or profit flips back to a big loss
calls.reason: Most of the $42B loss is a non-cash accounting charge and revenue grew 14-fold in a year, but $2T is ~30x run-rate sales and $518B compute commitments are a risk.
calls.quote: the hottest IPO of the year doesn't have to be bought on the first day. SpaceX just taught everybody that.

notes: No weekday/date stated by host; listing date used. SpaceX ticker not named in the video (recorded as 'SPACEX'). Anthropic is not yet public, so its entry is a watch/conditional view with no price. Investor meetings said to start Oct 14.
